nodes.label: RPM-to-playback-position audio
nodes.rationale: Maps RPM to position in a load-sweep recording rather than pitch-shifting.

nodes.label: Missing clips skipped gracefully
nodes.rationale: Game remains playable with an incomplete audio set.

nodes.label: RPM-to-recording-position playback (no pitch shift)
nodes.rationale: Plays short window at original speed rather than pitch-shifting, preserving timbre; limiter pulses the load sound.

nodes.label: Grip-loss sliding (no drift mode)
nodes.rationale: Slides emerge from power, weight transfer and handbrake grip loss instead of a scripted drift mode.

nodes.label: Room server (Socket.IO)
nodes.rationale: In-memory rooms, max 8, six-char codes; no auth

nodes.label: Client-side physics with 15 Hz snapshot relay
nodes.norm_label: client-side physics with 15 hz snapshot relay
nodes.rationale: Each browser runs own physics; server only relays; smoothing remote pos/yaw

nodes.label: Code-based free-drive rooms (max 8 players)
nodes.rationale: MVP scope: small rooms identified by six-character code; collisions, accounts, shared saves, ranking, anti-cheat deliberately excluded.

nodes.label: In-memory room data
nodes.rationale: Rooms vanish on server restart; acceptable for MVP.

nodes.label: No authoritative anti-cheat
nodes.rationale: Never trust client positions for rewards/rankings without server-authoritative simulation

nodes.label: Packet shape/bounds validation (no auth)
nodes.rationale: Server validates packets but does not authenticate users or verify ownership; client positions must not drive competitive results without server-authoritative simulation.

nodes.label: Visual peer cars (client-side physics)
nodes.rationale: Each browser runs its own driving physics; server only relays snapshots, keeping server simple at the cost of authority.

nodes.label: Kontroller (W/S, A/D, Q/E gears, Space handbrake, Esc)
nodes.norm_label: kontroller (w/s, a/d, q/e gears, space handbrake, esc)

nodes.label: 3-second driving income (speed × catalog price)
nodes.rationale: Income ties reward to actual driving speed and vehicle price class.

nodes.label: Procedural car fallback
nodes.rationale: Missing or broken GLB silently falls back to procedural visual; SkeletonUtils clone used because some GLBs are skinned.

nodes.label: Model length-fit, centering and grounding
nodes.rationale: Scales to game scale without altering real specs or physics; store camera adapts to bounding box without stretching proportions.
